Distress Tolerance Worksheet 7b   (Distress Tolerance Handout 9)
IMPROVE the Moment
Due Date:             Name:                                    Week Starting:
For each IMPROVE skill, write down what you did during the week, and write down a number to
indicate how effective the skill was in helping you tolerate the distress and cope with the situation
(keeping you from doing something to make the situation worse). Use the following scale:
I still couldn’t stand
the situation, even
for one more minute.
I was able to cope somewhat,
at least for a little while.
It helped somewhat.
I could use skills,
tolerated distress, and
resisted problem urges.
